lightningmod.configuration.title: Lightning Mod Settings
config.lightningmod.lightning_chance.too: The chance denominator for a lightning strike during a thunderstorm. Lower values mean more lightning. Vanilla: 100000.
config.lightningmod.skeleton_horse_chanc: Multiplier for the chance that lightning creates a skeleton horse trap. 1.0 is vanilla, 0.0 disables it.
config.lightningmod.lightning_in_all_bio: Allows lightning to strike in biomes where it normally cannot rain.
